verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing can charge in multiple currencies, but the only concrete evidence on this axis is a Stripe PM confirming that multi-currency subscriptions require creating a separate plan per currency rather than native per-currency price points on one price object, and no evidence shows consolidated reporting that converts multi-currency revenue into a single home-currency view. Missing for 10: documented multi-currency price objects (single price with per-currency amounts), and explicit consolidated/rolled-up reporting in a home currency across currencies.
